_note: THIS IS OUR RECORD OF WHAT EACH MEMBER DECLARED, not a surface a member writes. A kit-drift FIGURE alone cannot be acted on: '5 DIFF' does not say whether the member considered the file, declined it, or never saw it — and a member that declared a fork and one that silently diverged produce the same figure. Each entry carries the source that recorded it and the instant, so a reader can check it rather than trust it.
